title: A failure whose outcome is no-answer or refused but which came with an answer from the provider is worded 'did not answer' when it has no hint of its own
evidence: Found in R6 PR 3b (US-10 AC17, PR 2115). describeStorageFailure (packages/health-core/src/sync-manager.ts) words every failure without a hint and without may-have-landed as '{provider} did not answer. Nothing was written'. Some of these carry an answer: Drive's record lookup with incompleteSearch or invalid metadata (drive-rest-record.ts unusable), Drive's folder create answered with no id (drive-rest-files.ts driveCreateFolder), GitHub's public repository (github.ts assertPrivate), and a provider rate limit. 'Nothing was written' is true; 'did not answer' is not. Surfaces that draw this sentence: the hosted MCP (app/lib/mcp.server.ts), the iPhone (ios/engine/cloud-adapters.ts failed) and the CLI and stdio server (tools/). The web page does not call it. Same family as the open wording question in docs/drafts/r6-typed-storage-outcome-design.md (Waiting on Brad, item 2). The exact words wait for the owner.
